- **Time Complexity**: Initialization is $O(1)$ relative to grid size for setting up dimensions, but $O(N)$ for grid tensor creation where $N$ is the total number of grid cells.
- **Memory Complexity**: $O(G)$ where $G$ is the total number of grid cells ($gridSize_x \times gridSize_y \times gridSize_z$) for storing grid metadata.

- **When not to use**: Do not use if you need a complete, self-contained rendering pipeline without custom tensor decomposition.
